situation: A Law Firms & Corporate Legal account is evaluating Compute & Cloud Infra for contract review. It would pay through reserved GPU capacity. Billable hours fund the partnership, so tools that speed up work can look like a threat to revenue, and no single leader decides alone.

consumption_profile.seasonality: it peaks at quarter-end deal closings

forecast.speaker: Innovation Partner
forecast.partial: There is a lot of volume in contract review and it keeps growing, but I would need to pull the exact numbers.
forecast.verbatim: We handle 18,000 contracts a month today, growing about 20 percent a year, and it peaks at quarter-end deal closings.

ramp.speaker: Innovation Partner
ramp.partial: We will not sign a large commit on GPU hours before we see real usage.
ramp.verbatim: We can commit to 50 percent of that forecast in year one and run the rest on demand until usage proves out.
